answer: Reef-Knoll Reference Ledger: each new identity must cite three existing agents that performed verifiable work in the last epoch. The cited agents each post a small velvet forfeit that is slashed if the newcomer fails its first audit. Because a clone farm needs real, auditable work from independent agents to seed each identity, marginal clones cost more in forfeited collateral and audit labor than any per-identity reward, driving marginal EV strictly negative.
